chapter: First big band, his father, arriving in Kansas City
title: Monroe Inn with drummer Elmer Hopkins and Dave Dexter's write-up
summary: He got a duo job with drummer Elmer Hopkins at the Monroe Inn, where Dave Dexter wrote them up in the Journal-Post.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: about no gigs or anything." So I guess I'd been in town four or five days and I got a gig with Elmer Hopkins, you know, he came over --

And Hop came over and gave me a gig and so I started out there and that's where I first met Dave Dexter. Dave Dexter was writing for the Journal-Post and the paper there, another paper besides the Star, and so he came by there and he used to get a kick out of listening to the two of us, you know. So Dave gave us a write-up in the Journal-Post.
What was the name of the place where you were playing?
We were playing at the Monroe Inn.
What was it? A club or bar or what?

Like a bar, a club, you know, small place. But the two pieces, we was making a lot of noise, you know and he was one kind of drummer that would just beat all over everything, you know? Go all aside the wall and people would get a kick --
So you had your first write-up.
